title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode2 Outcast Plushies

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_wonder_op1
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that phoenix appeared to be headed in this direction...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hey, check it out! I got a big balloon!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Oh, we should go down to the water together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting this harbor to be a part of such a bustling city.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Look at all the plushies!
It's like a big festival!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Excuse me. Did any of you happen to see a large bird flying overhead?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: No, sorry. I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
I see. Thank you.
Enjoy yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There are so many plushies here, but none of them seem to know anything about that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I tried asking around too. They all said they didn't see it either...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
But we may want to keep asking.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Plus, Tsukasa and the others still might learn something—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, all of you!
We have some good news!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You have good news?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! While talking to some of the plushies...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We found that none of them knew anything about that phoenix, but they told us instead to ask around at the inn.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Apparently, lots of different plushies from all over gather there to talk about the rumors they've heard and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, which means one of them may've seen or heard something about that phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's try heading over there.
Outside the Inn

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The inn's supposed to be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
It sounds like there's a fun party going on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, is it coming from that place?!
I'm seeing a lot of plushies gathered outside talking☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It is like a party!
Wait, is that the inn we're looking for?

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Ah, are you all guests?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And you are?

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line:
I'm the innkeeper.
We have a party going on today.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: So, why don't you all join in on the fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ I wanna talk to the plushies♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we're here to investigate!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
Joining in on this celebration may actually make it easier for us to draw out information.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: People do tend to be more talkative when they're in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Good point...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, we can split up and ask around, while also enjoying this party!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I don't know anything about this phoenix of yours.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
A phoenix? Like the mythical creature?
Are you sure you saw one?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Sorry we can't help you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, thanks for talking to us!
You guys enjoy yourselves☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... No one here seems to know anything about that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose information should be difficult to come by considering how incredibly rare a creature it seems to be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Hey, wanna hear me sing?
I'm from an island where everyone's a great singer!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: I'm looking for work. I'll do anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm seeing so many different types of plushies here. Mermaids, androids...

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Well, of course! What you're seeing here is a gathering of plushies from all different islands.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, does that mean there's a Mermaid Island and an Android Island?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mermaids and androids...
Hehe. It reminds me of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Do you think that's important?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: SEKAI was born out of Tsukasa's feelings, so they may be a reflection of his personal experiences.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really never a dull moment here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa, look! What's going on with those plushies?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh no!
They're hurt all over!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some have their eyes popped out, and others are wrapped in bandages... I feel really bad for them...

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line:
Haha. Don't feel bad!
They're from Zombie Island!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay☆
They're zombies! Now it all makes sense!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, there's no need to worry♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Are you gonna ask them about that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but... Would that be a bad idea?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Just be careful!
The last time I tried talking to them, they decided to bite me for no reason!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Th-They bit you...?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
I didn't get hurt...
But they're a really grumpy bunch, so be really careful when you go over to talk to them.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like they're a bit of an odd bunch.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: They're not actually evil or anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is that so?

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah. In the beginning, they tried their best to make friends with everyone. You see, biting someone is apparently how folks greet each other on their island.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: But people have a tendency to judge a book by its cover, and they were misunderstood...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Misunderstood...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really...?
That's so sad...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Imagine wanting to get to know someone better, but them feeling scared of how you look and the way you greet them. That'd definitely make me sad...

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Which is why they're somewhat prickly now. They've completely given up on trying to get along with everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Still, aren't they lonely...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, we should try talking to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They may know something about that phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello there.
Do you all have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We have a question for you all.
We're looking for a phoenix that—

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh my.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
H-He bit you!
Are you hurt, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm okay. It doesn't hurt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, perhaps he's replying to my initial greeting with his own?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I should give a greeting in return.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Pardon me.
CHOMP.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna chomp too!
That looks like fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too☆
CHOMP.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you all doing...?
Weirdos...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, there's something we wanna ask you zombies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're looking for a phoenix☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But we don't know where it went...
Do you guys happen to know anything about it?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
A phoenix...?
Are you talking about...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: No, I'm not telling you anything!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, why not?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
Because you're trying to trick us!
You're not trying to become our friends! You think we're ugly and say nasty things about us behind our backs!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line:
What he said!
You hate us, so why should we help you?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, that's not true!
We don't hate you...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Hmph... You're lying.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Everyone else before you ran away scared when we tried to make friends with them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's true that some of the other plushies are scared of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But dispelling them of those fears should help you all get along better. Help them understand that you want to become friends with them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, he's right!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Y-You think that would work...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah☆ So, let's go over and talk to them♪ I'll help you guys break the ice!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: No, go away!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Because there's no way we can ever be friends...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There's no way...?)

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Hmph... Let's go. We're leaving!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Those zombies seemed so sad...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And if nothing changes, they're gonna keep getting misunderstood...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
Nothing's wrong. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They reminded me of my own past...
